crossRefs.note: By their fruits you will know them. Do you gather grapes from thorns, or figs from thistles?
“Either make the tree good, and its fruit good, or make the tree corrupt, and its fruit corrupt; for the tree is known…
You offspring of vipers, how can you, being evil, speak good things? For out of the abundance of the heart, the mouth…
For out of the heart come evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, sexual sins, thefts, false testimony, and blasphemies.

translations.web: As the proverb of the ancients says, ‘Out of the wicked comes wickedness;’ but my hand will not be on you.
translations.bsb: As the old proverb says, ‘Wickedness proceeds from the wicked.’ But my hand will never be against you.
translations.kjv: As saith the proverb of the ancients, Wickedness proceedeth from the wicked: but mine hand shall not be upon thee.
translations.asv: As saith the proverb of the ancients, Out of the wicked cometh forth wickedness; but my hand shall not be upon thee.
